welcome.speaker: Chair
welcome.text: Distinguished delegates, the meeting is called to order. Today we consider equitable access to vaccines. We will hear national positions, consult on the draft, and seek consensus.

evidence.speaker: Secretariat
evidence.text: The shared pool contains one hundred million courses. Kitala has the greatest immediate need. Pelagia faces delivery constraints. The task is to agree on allocation, financing, and accountability.

nordland.speaker: Nordland
nordland.text: Thank you, Chair. We support a shared response. However, our parliament requires public reporting on donor funds. We can support financing only if the agreement includes clear accountability.

meridia.speaker: Meridia
meridia.text: Thank you, Chair. Reliable supply requires reliable commitments. We ask for a production purchase guarantee and an allocation that we can explain to our own population.

recognize.speaker: Chair
recognize.text: I now give the floor to the distinguished delegate of Kitala. Please present your proposal.

statement_equity.speaker: Kitala
statement_equity.text: Thank you, Chair. We propose thirty five percent of the pool for Kitala, supported by donor financing and delivery assistance. We are ready to discuss reporting and production commitments to reach agreement.

statement_national.speaker: Kitala
statement_national.text: Thank you, Chair. Our needs are urgent. We request fifty percent of the shared pool for Kitala. We ask other delegations to accept this allocation without additional conditions.

consult.speaker: Nordland
consult.text: Let us look for a package we can both support. We could provide thirty five million credits if quarterly public reporting is included. Ten million should support delivery in Pelagia. Can you accept that wording?

agree.speaker: Nordland
agree.text: That addresses our concern. We can support the financing clause on that basis. You will still need to resolve Meridia's production requirement and the allocation across all delegations.

reject.speaker: Nordland
reject.text: Without public reporting, I cannot commit these funds. Our objection remains. Please revise the accountability clause if you want us to support the package.

shock.speaker: Secretariat
shock.text: Chair, we have a supply update. A manufacturing disruption has reduced the pool to eighty million courses. Every allocation now delivers fewer courses. Meridia has also revised its minimum allocation to thirty percent.

consensus.speaker: Chair
consensus.text: We have before us the revised draft. I invite delegations to indicate whether they object to its adoption. This teaching exercise proceeds by consensus.

adopted.speaker: Chair
adopted.text: I see no objection. The text is adopted. The final policy agreement records our shared commitments on allocation, financing, delivery support, accountability, and production. Delegates, please review and download the agreement report. This session is now closed.

failed.speaker: Chair
failed.text: An objection remains. Consensus has not been reached. I invite delegations to return to consultations. Consider what a revised package would need to address.

recognize_k.speaker: Chair
recognize_k.text: I now give the floor to the distinguished delegate of Kitala. Please present your position.

recognize_n.speaker: Chair
recognize_n.text: I now give the floor to the distinguished delegate of Nordland. Please present your position.

recognize_m.speaker: Chair
recognize_m.text: I now give the floor to the distinguished delegate of Meridia. Please present your position.

recognize_p.speaker: Chair
recognize_p.text: I now give the floor to the distinguished delegate of Pelagia. Please present your position.

role_n_report.speaker: Nordland
role_n_report.text: Thank you, Chair. We require quarterly public reporting. We can discuss thirty five million credits of financing within that accountable framework.

role_n_discuss.speaker: Nordland
role_n_discuss.text: Thank you, Chair. We invite discussion on accountability. Our mandate still requires public reporting before we can support a final agreement.

role_m_guarantee.speaker: Meridia
role_m_guarantee.text: Thank you, Chair. We require a production purchase guarantee and an allocation within our mandate. This certainty will help us support the collective package.

role_m_unresolved.speaker: Meridia
role_m_unresolved.text: Thank you, Chair. The guarantee remains unresolved in the working text. We will need to return to it before adoption.

role_p_delivery.speaker: Pelagia
role_p_delivery.text: Thank you, Chair. We request ten million credits for delivery support. International access must include the means to reach remote communities.

role_p_unresolved.speaker: Pelagia
role_p_unresolved.text: Thank you, Chair. Delivery support remains unresolved. We must return to this funding gap before a final agreement can meet our mandate.
